title: [29.x]No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created
summary: Austrian localization now assigns the EMPLEXP employee posting group when creating new employee templates and demo employees, fixing a bug where the posting group field was incorrectly cleared.
key_points: ADMINISTRATION and IT employee templates in the AT demo data now get an employee posting group
Demo employees created from these templates now carry the posting group
The subscriber now assigns EMPLEXP instead of clearing the field
quote: The AT localization subscriber explicitly cleared the "Employee Posting Group" field while inserting these employee templates.
